text: Switch an OpenAI-SDK client to Together models by changing only the API key and base URL
quote: you can point it at models hosted on Together with two changes: the API key and base URL

text: Access 100+ open-source models with transparent per-token pricing and no provisioning delay
quote: Call 100+ open-source models with per-token pricing and no provisioning latency.

text: Run asynchronous batch inference jobs at up to 50% lower cost than real-time
quote: Run asynchronous batch workloads at up to 50% lower cost.

text: Serve a model on reserved dedicated hardware for better performance and no hard rate limits
quote: Dedicated model inference (DMI) lets you serve a model on reserved hardware... Better performance... No hard rate limits

text: Configure a dedicated deployment to autoscale by setting replica limits
quote: Configure your deployment to scale automatically by setting limits on how many replicas it can run.

text: Spin up H100/B200 GPU clusters with attached storage for training or large batch jobs
quote: Spin up H100 and B200 clusters with attached storage for training or large batch jobs.

text: Prototype on serverless endpoints then move to reserved hardware without changing application code
quote: you can prototype on serverless and move to reserved hardware later without changing your application code

text: Together AI handles the full fine-tuning lifecycle: data upload, training, hosting, and inference
quote: Fine-tuning tailors a pretrained model to a smaller, targeted dataset so it performs better on a specific task or domain. Together AI handles the full lifecycle: data upload, training, hosting, and inference

text: Launch a fine-tuning job from the console, API/SDK, or CLI
quote: You can launch a fine-tuning job from the console, through the API/SDK, or with the CLI

text: Deploy a model you fine-tuned from a supported base model for inference
quote: Fine-tuned models: Deploy a model you fine-tuned from a supported base model.

text: Train small LoRA adapter weights on top of a frozen base model instead of full fine-tuning
quote: LoRA: Trains a small set of adapter weights on top of the frozen base model... Full fine-tuning: Updates every weight in the base model.

text: Get JSON output that conforms to a supplied schema so responses parse reliably in code
quote: Supported models can return JSON that conforms to any schema you supply, so you can read the output directly in code without retries or fragile parsing.

text: Use function/tool calling so models return structured function names and arguments to execute
quote: Function calling (also called tool calling) lets LLMs respond with structured function names and arguments that you can execute in your application.

text: Chain tool calls within a single response (multi-step) or across many turns (multi-turn) to build agent loops
quote: To build agent loops, chain tool calls inside one response (multi-step), and conversations that thread tools across many turns (multi-turn).

text: Ready-made coding-agent skills teach agents correct Together AI code patterns (model IDs, SDK usage)
quote: Make your AI coding agent Together-AI-aware with ready-made skills for code generation and an MCP server for live docs lookup.

text: Official docs MCP server gives an agent live access to documentation for lookup without leaving the editor
quote: Gives your agent live access to this documentation site so it can look up current information without leaving your editor.

text: Repeated prompt prefixes are automatically served from a shared cache and billed at a discounted rate
quote: Automatic: There is no header, parameter, or account toggle to enable it. Send the same prompt prefix again and any portion that's still warm in the shared cache is billed at the cached rate.

text: Rate limits are dynamic per organization/model, adjusting based on live capacity and recent usage
quote: Together uses dynamic rate limits instead of fixed thresholds. Each organization has a dynamic rate per model that adjusts based on: The model's live capacity. Your recent successful usage on that model.

text: Stream completions token by token via Server Sent Events
quote: We provide support for streaming responses using Server Sent Events (SSE).

text: Official CLI can deploy dedicated endpoints for a given model with a single command
quote: tg beta endpoints deploy google/gemma-4-E4B-it --endpoint my-endpoint

text: Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK provides convenient server-side access to the REST API
quote: This library provides convenient access to the Together REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.

text: Single API supports chat, image, audio, and embedding model calls
quote: Call chat, image, audio, embedding, and more through one API.

text: Same unified API also exposes an embeddings endpoint for retrieval pipelines
quote: Call chat, image, audio, embedding, and more through one API.
